comment: Scrub - records the last 6 seconds and lets you move through them with a knob; where you stop, a grain of sound keeps looping (a freeze). Pos = where the read head is, 0 = Range ago, 100 = now; turning it slides through the audio like dragging tape, stopping freezes the grain there. Grain = length of the looping grain (10 ms buzz to 1 s loop); Rec = LIVE (keeps recording: a delay you can sweep), HOLD (stops recording: scrub and freeze the last 6 s), STOMP (records while the effect is off, freezes when you switch it on; untested); Glide = how slowly the head follows Pos; Range = how much of the past Pos spans (0.1 to 4 s); Spray = random offset per grain, a cloud instead of a loop; Mix is a DJ-style dry/wet crossfade.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub (this pack). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Pos
params.comment: Where the read head is in the recorded past: 0 = Range ago, 100 = now (in HOLD: the moment you froze). Turn it to scrub; stop and the grain there loops. Default 100.

params.name: Grain
params.comment: Length of the looping grain, 10 ms to 1 s (log), shown in ms. Short = a buzzing tone made of the sound, long = a loop of a whole hit or chord. Default 50 = 100 ms.

params.name: Rec
params.comment: LIVE = the buffer keeps recording, Pos is how far back you listen (a delay you can sweep). HOLD = recording stops, Pos scrubs through the last 6 seconds. STOMP = records while the effect is switched off, freezes the moment you switch it on (untested on the pedal). Default LIVE.

params.name: Glide
params.comment: How slowly the head follows Pos. 0 = jumps straight there, 40 = about 0.1 s, 70 = about 1 s, 100 = about 3 s: a slow tape-like glide. Default 40.

params.name: Range
params.comment: How much of the past the Pos knob spans, 0.1 s to 4 s (log), shown in ms or s. Small = fine scrubbing inside one hit. Default 100 = 4 s.

params.name: Spray
params.comment: Random offset for each new grain, up to 0.5 s. 0 = the freeze is a steady loop, higher = a moving cloud around the head. Default 0.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full from 0 to 50, wet full from 50 to 100, both full at 50. Default 50: you play over the frozen sound.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
